title.en: Hajj and Umrah: the holiday in Makkah
title.ur: Hajj aur Umrah: Makkah mein chhutti

intro.en: Rana asks her aunt Hind about her holiday. Hind spends it in Madinah and Makkah: she visits the Prophet's Mosque, performs Umrah, fasts, prays and walks around the Kaaba.
intro.ur: Rana apni khala Hind se unki chhutti ke bare mein poochti hai. Hind chhutti Madinah aur Makkah mein guzarti hain: Masjid-e-Nabawi ki ziyarat, Umrah, roza, namaz aur Kaaba ka tawaf.
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ رَنا خالَتَها هِنْدًا عَنْ عُطْلَتِها. تَقْضيها هِنْدٌ في المَدينَةِ وَمَكَّةَ: تَزورُ المَسْجِدَ النَّبَوِيَّ وَتَعْتَمِرُ وَتَصومُ وَتُصَلّي وَتَطوفُ حَوْلَ الكَعْبَةِ.

dialogue.ar: يا خالَتي، في أَيِّ شَهْرٍ تَبْدَأُ عُطْلَتُكِ؟
dialogue.tr: yā khālatī, fī ayyi shahrin tabdaʾu ʿuṭlatuki?
dialogue.en: Aunt, in which month does your holiday begin?
dialogue.ur: Khala, aapki chhutti kis mahine mein shuru hoti hai?

dialogue.ar: في شَهْرِ شَعْبانَ، قَبْلَ رَمَضانَ.
dialogue.tr: fī shahri Shaʿbān, qabla Ramaḍān
dialogue.en: In the month of Shaban, before Ramadan.
dialogue.ur: Shaban ke mahine mein, Ramazan se pehle.

dialogue.ar: وَأَيْنَ تَقْضينَ العُطْلَةَ؟
dialogue.tr: wa ayna taqḍīna l-ʿuṭla?
dialogue.en: And where do you spend the holiday?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap chhutti kahan guzarti hain?

dialogue.ar: أَقْضيها في المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ ثُمَّ في مَكَّةَ المُكَرَّمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: aqḍīhā fī l-Madīnati l-munawwarati thumma fī Makkata l-mukarrama
dialogue.en: I spend it in Madinah and then in Makkah.
dialogue.ur: Main use pehle Madinah Munawwarah aur phir Makkah Mukarramah mein guzarti hoon.

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَفْعَلينَ في المَدينَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā tafʿalīna fī l-madīna?
dialogue.en: What do you do in Madinah?
dialogue.ur: Aap Madinah mein kya karti hain?

dialogue.ar: المَسْجِدُ النَّبَوِيُّ هُوَ مَكاني الأَوَّلُ، فَأَزورُهُ وَأُصَلّي فيهِ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: al-masjidu n-nabawiyyu huwa makānī l-awwal, fa-azūruhu wa uṣallī fīhi kathīran
dialogue.en: The Prophet’s Mosque is my first place, so I visit it and pray there a lot.
dialogue.ur: Masjid-e-Nabawi meri pehli jagah hai, to main wahan jaati hoon aur bohat namaz parhti hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا تَفْعَلينَ في مَكَّةَ في أَوَّلِ الأَيّامِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mādhā tafʿalīna fī Makka fī awwali l-ayyām?
dialogue.en: And what do you do in Makkah in the first days?
dialogue.ur: Aur Makkah mein shuru ke dinon mein aap kya karti hain?

dialogue.ar: أَبْدَأُ بِالعُمْرَةِ، ثُمَّ أَقْضي وَقْتي في الصَّلاةِ وَالصِّيامِ.
dialogue.tr: abdaʾu bil-ʿumra, thumma aqḍī waqtī fiṣ-ṣalāti wa ṣ-ṣiyām
dialogue.en: I begin with Umrah, then I spend my time in prayer and fasting.
dialogue.ur: Main Umrah se shuru karti hoon, phir apna waqt namaz aur roze mein guzarti hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا تَفْعَلينَ حَوْلَ الكَعْبَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mādhā tafʿalīna ḥawla l-kaʿba?
dialogue.en: And what do you do around the Kaaba?
dialogue.ur: Aur Kaaba ke gird aap kya karti hain?

dialogue.ar: أَطوفُ حَوْلَها، وَأَدْعو اللهَ.
dialogue.tr: aṭūfu ḥawlahā, wa adʿū llāh
dialogue.en: I walk around it and call upon Allah.
dialogue.ur: Main uska tawaf karti hoon, aur Allah se dua karti hoon.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ شَوْطاً تَطوفينَ؟
dialogue.tr: kam shawṭan taṭūfīn?
dialogue.en: How many circuits do you walk?
dialogue.ur: Aap kitne chakkar tawaf karti hain?

dialogue.ar: سَبْعَةً، ثُمَّ أُصَلّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَريباً مِنْ مَقامِ إِبْراهيمَ.
dialogue.tr: sabʿatan, thumma uṣallī rakʿatayni qarīban min maqāmi Ibrāhīm
dialogue.en: Seven, then I pray two rak'ahs near the Station of Ibrahim.
dialogue.ur: Saat, phir main Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke qareeb do rakat namaz parhti hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَأَيّامُ العيدِ، أَيْنَ تَكونينَ فيها؟
dialogue.tr: wa ayyāmu l-ʿīd, ayna takūnīna fīhā?
dialogue.en: And the days of Eid, where are you in them?
dialogue.ur: Aur Eid ke din, aap unmein kahan hoti hain?

dialogue.ar: في مَكَّةَ مَرَّةً، وَفي المَدينَةِ مَرَّةً أُخْرى.
dialogue.tr: fī Makka marratan, wa fī l-Madīnati marratan ukhrā
dialogue.en: Once in Makkah, another time in Madinah.
dialogue.ur: Ek baar Makkah mein, aur ek baar Madinah mein.

dialogue.ar: بِمَ تَشْعُرينَ هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: bima tashʿurīna hunāk?
dialogue.en: What do you feel there?
dialogue.ur: Wahan aap kya mehsoos karti hain?

dialogue.ar: أَشْعُرُ بِالسُّرورِ.
dialogue.tr: ashʿuru bis-surūr
dialogue.en: I feel joy.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe khushi mehsoos hoti hai.

q.ur: Hind ki chhutti kab shuru hoti hai?

q.en: Where does Hind spend the holiday?
How many circuits (ashwat) does Hind walk around the Kaaba?
q.ur: Hind Kaaba ke kitne chakkar (ashwat) lagati hai?
q.ar: كَمْ شَوْطاً تَطوفُ هِنْدٌ حَوْلَ الكَعْبَةِ؟

options_ar: يَمْتَنِعُ عَنِ الطَّعامِ وَالشَّرابِ تَعَبُّدًا للهِ

q.en: Where does Hind pray two rak'ahs after the tawaf?
q.ur: Hind tawaf ke baad do rakat kahan parhti hai?
q.ar: أَيْنَ تُصَلّي هِنْدٌ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الطَّوافِ؟

intro.en: Learn the words for the steps of Umrah: reaching the Miqat, wearing the Ihram clothes, saying the Talbiyah, circling the Kaaba, walking between Safa and Marwa, and shaving the head.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Umrah ke marahil ke alfaaz seekhenge: Miqat par pahunchna, Ihram ke kapde pehenna, talbiyah kehna, Kaaba ka tawaf, Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan sai, aur sar ke baal mundwana.
intro.ar: تَعَلَّمْ كَلِماتِ مَناسِكِ العُمْرَةِ بِالتَّرْتيبِ: الوُصولُ إِلى المِيقاتِ، وَلُبْسُ ثَوْبِ الإِحْرامِ، وَالتَّلْبِيَةُ، وَالطَّوافُ بِالكَعْبَةِ، وَالسَّعْيُ بَيْنَ الصَّفا وَالمَرْوَةِ، وَحَلْقُ الرَّأْسِ.

q.en: What does يَلْبَسُ ثَوْبَ الإِحْرَامِ mean?

options: He takes off the Ihram clothes

q.en: What does يَسْعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالمَرْوَةِ mean?
q.ur: يَسْعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالمَرْوَةِ ka matlab?

options: He walks between Safa and Marwa

q.ar: أَيُّ فِعْلٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى بُلوغِ المَكانِ؟

q.en: In the book's order, what comes first?
q.ur: Kitab ki tarteeb mein sab se pehle kya aata hai?
q.ar: ما أَوَّلُ ما يَحْدُثُ بِحَسَبِ تَرْتيبِ الكِتابِ؟

intro.en: A young pilgrim, Bilal, asks his group guide about the days of Hajj: standing at Arafah, going to Muzdalifah, then Mina, and the farewell tawaf. Follow the order of the events.
intro.ur: Ek jawan haji Bilal apne guide se Hajj ke dinon ke bare mein poochta hai: Arafah mein wuqoof, phir Muzdalifah, phir Mina aur tawaf-e-wida. Waqiyaat ki tarteeb dhyan se dekhein.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ بِلالٌ، وَهُوَ حاجٌّ شابٌّ، مُرْشِدَ المَجْموعَةِ عَنْ أَيّامِ الحَجِّ: الوُقوفُ بِعَرَفَةَ، ثُمَّ الذَّهابُ إِلى مُزْدَلِفَةَ، ثُمَّ مِنًى، وَطَوافُ الوَداعِ. تابِعْ تَرْتيبَ الأَحْداثِ.

dialogue.ar: يا مُرْشِدُ، مَتى نَقِفُ بِعَرَفَةَ؟
dialogue.tr: yā murshid, matā naqifu bi-ʿArafa?
dialogue.en: Guide, when do we stand at Arafah?
dialogue.ur: Guide sahab, hum Arafah mein kab wuqoof karte hain?

dialogue.ar: في اليَوْمِ التّاسِعِ مِنْ ذي الحِجَّةِ، وَيَبْدَأُ الوَقْتُ بَعْدَ الزَّوالِ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-yawmi t-tāsiʿi min dhī l-ḥijja, wa yabdaʾu l-waqtu baʿda z-zawāl
dialogue.en: On the ninth day of Dhul-Hijjah, and the time begins after the sun passes noon.
dialogue.ur: Dhul-Hijjah ki nawein tareekh ko, aur waqt sooraj dhalne ke baad shuru hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما أَمْرُ الصَّلاةِ في عَرَفَةَ يا مُرْشِدُ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mā amru ṣ-ṣalāti fī ʿArafa yā murshid?
dialogue.en: And what about prayer at Arafah, guide?
dialogue.ur: Aur Arafah mein namaz ka kya tareeqa hai, guide sahab?

dialogue.ar: نَجْمَعُ الظُّهْرَ وَالعَصْرَ، وَنَقْصُرُهُما في وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ.
dialogue.tr: najmaʿu ẓ-ẓuhra wa l-ʿaṣr, wa naqṣuruhumā fī waqti ẓ-ẓuhr
dialogue.en: We combine Zuhr and Asr, and shorten them at the time of Zuhr.
dialogue.ur: Hum Zuhr aur Asr ko jama karte hain, aur Zuhr ke waqt unhein qasr karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَإِلى أَيْنَ نَذْهَبُ بَعْدَ غُروبِ الشَّمْسِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa ilā ayna nadhhabu baʿda ghurūbi sh-shams?
dialogue.en: And where do we go after sunset?
dialogue.ur: Aur sooraj dubne ke baad hum kahan jaate hain?

dialogue.ar: نَذْهَبُ إِلى مُزْدَلِفَةَ، وَنَجْمَعُ فيها بَيْنَ المَغْرِبِ وَالعِشاءِ.
dialogue.tr: nadhhabu ilā Muzdalifa, wa najmaʿu fīhā bayna l-maghribi wa l-ʿishāʾ
dialogue.en: We go to Muzdalifah, and there we combine Maghrib and Isha.
dialogue.ur: Hum Muzdalifah jaate hain, aur wahan Maghrib aur Isha ko jama karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا نَفْعَلُ صَباحَ العيدِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mādhā nafʿalu ṣabāḥa l-ʿīd?
dialogue.en: And what do we do on the morning of Eid?
dialogue.ur: Aur Eid ki subah hum kya karte hain?

dialogue.ar: نَذْهَبُ إِلى مِنًى، وَنَرْمي الجَمْرَةَ الكُبْرى.
dialogue.tr: nadhhabu ilā Minā, wa narmī l-jamrata l-kubrā
dialogue.en: We go to Mina and throw pebbles at the Great Jamrah.
dialogue.ur: Hum Mina jaate hain, aur bari jamrah ko kankariyan maarte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda dhālik?
dialogue.en: And after that?
dialogue.ur: Aur uske baad?

dialogue.ar: نَذْبَحُ الهَدْيَ، ثُمَّ نَحْلِقُ رُؤوسَنا.
dialogue.tr: nadhbaḥu l-hadya, thumma naḥliqu ruʾūsanā
dialogue.en: We slaughter the sacrificial animal, then we shave our heads.
dialogue.ur: Hum hadi zabah karte hain, phir apne sar mundwate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ إِلى أَيْنَ نَذْهَبُ؟
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda dhālika ilā ayna nadhhab?
dialogue.en: And after that, where do we go?
dialogue.ur: Aur uske baad hum kahan jaate hain?

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ نَطوفُ بِالبَيْتِ طَوافَ الإِفاضَةِ، ثُمَّ نَسْعى بَيْنَ الصَّفا وَالمَرْوَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda dhālika naṭūfu bil-bayti ṭawāfa l-ifāḍa, thumma nasʿā bayna ṣ-Ṣafā wa l-Marwa
dialogue.en: After that we do the Tawaf of Ifadah around the House, then walk the Sa’i between Safa and Marwa.
dialogue.ur: Uske baad hum Baitullah ka tawaf-e-ifadah karte hain, phir Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan sai karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمَتى يَكونُ طَوافُ الوَداعِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa matā yakūnu ṭawāfu l-wadāʿ?
dialogue.en: And when is the farewell Tawaf?
dialogue.ur: Aur tawaf-e-wida kab hota hai?

dialogue.ar: يَكونُ في آخِرِ الحَجِّ، بَعْدَ رَمْيِ الجَمَراتِ.
dialogue.tr: yakūnu fī ākhiri l-ḥajj, baʿda ramyi l-jamarāt
dialogue.en: It is at the end of Hajj, after throwing the pebbles at the Jamarat.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Hajj ke aakhir mein hota hai, jamarat ko kankariyan maarne ke baad.

vocab.en: he throws pebbles at the Jamarat
vocab.ur: woh jamarat ko kankar marta hai

options: The place of standing in Hajj

q.en: When do the pilgrims go to Muzdalifah in the dialogue?
q.ur: Dialogue ke mutabiq hujjaj Muzdalifah kab jaate hain?
q.ar: مَتى يَذْهَبُ الحُجّاجُ إِلى مُزْدَلِفَةَ في الحِوارِ؟

options: Before dawn on the first day

q.en: Which prayers are prayed at Muzdalifah in the dialogue?
q.ur: Dialogue mein Muzdalifah mein kaun si namazein padhi jaati hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ صَلاتَيْنِ تُصَلَّيانِ في مُزْدَلِفَةَ في الحِوارِ؟

intro.en: Learn to count from eleven to nineteen. Each number is made of a unit word plus عَشَرَ (ten).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum 11 se 19 tak ginti seekhenge. Har adad ek chhote adad aur عَشَرَ (das) se milkar banta hai.
intro.ar: تَعَلَّمِ العَدَّ مِنْ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ إِلى تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ. يَتَكَوَّنُ كُلُّ عَدَدٍ مِنْ كَلِمَةِ الآحادِ مَعَ كَلِمَةِ «عَشَرَ».

q.ur: 12 ko Arabi mein kya kehte hain?

title.en: Sentence patterns: when, where, how many
title.ur: Jumlon ke andaaz: kab, kahan, kitna

intro.en: Practise question patterns: مَتَى (when), أَيْنَ (where), كَمْ (how many), with the months of the year and 'in the Eid days'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum sawaal ke andaaz mashq karenge: مَتَى (kab), أَيْنَ (kahan), كَمْ (kitna), aur mahinon ke naam.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى أَدَواتِ الاسْتِفْهامِ: مَتى، أَيْنَ، كَمْ، مَعَ أَسْماءِ الشُّهورِ وَعِبارَةِ «في أَيّامِ العيدِ».

q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ تُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ المَكانِ؟
أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ تُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ العَدَدِ؟

q.en: How do you say 'The holiday is in the month of Ramadan'?
q.ur: 'Chhutti Ramazan ke mahine mein hai' kaise kahenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَقولُ إِنَّ العُطْلَةَ في شَهْرِ رَمَضانَ؟

q.en: Which sentence means 'I took off the Ihram clothes'?
q.ur: Kaunsa jumla 'maine Ihram ke kapde utaare' hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تُخْبِرُ بِأَنَّكَ نَزَعْتَ ثَوْبَ الإِحْرامِ؟

title.en: Sounds and listening: the long sound ـِي
title.ur: Awaazein aur sunna: lambi ـِي ki awaaz

intro.en: Listen and repeat words that have the short kasra (ـِ) and the long ـِي sound, like in سَلِيم and جَمِيل. Then listen to complete sentences.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum chhoti zer (ـِ) aur lambi ـِي ki awaaz suntay aur dohrate hain, jaise سَلِيم aur جَمِيل mein. Phir jumle sun kar mukammal karte hain.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرْ كَلِماتٍ فيها الكَسْرَةُ القَصيرَةُ وَالكَسْرَةُ الطَّويلَةُ (ياءُ المَدِّ) كَما في سَلِيم وَجَمِيل. ثُمَّ اسْتَمِعْ إِلى جُمَلٍ كامِلَةٍ.

q.en: Which word has the long ـِي sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi ـِي ki awaaz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها ياءُ مَدٍّ بَعْدَ كَسْرَةٍ؟

q.en: Which word has the long ـِي sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi ـِي ki awaaz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ أُخْرى فيها ياءُ مَدٍّ بَعْدَ كَسْرَةٍ؟

q.en: Which sura is read in the sound exercise?
q.ur: Awaaz ki mashq mein kaun si surat parhi jati hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سورَةٍ تُقْرَأُ في تَمْرينِ الأَصْواتِ؟

intro.en: Practise asking and answering with a friend: where do you spend the week's holiday, what do you do in Makkah, what do you feel in Makkah, where do you spend Eid, and what do you do after the tawaf.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum dost ke sath sawal jawab ki mashq karte hain: chhutti kahan guzarte ho, Makkah mein kya karte ho, kya mehsoos karte ho, Eid kahan guzarte ho, tawaf ke baad kya karte ho.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ صَديقِكَ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ: أَيْنَ تَقْضي عُطْلَةَ الأُسْبوعِ؟ ماذا تَفْعَلُ في مَكَّةَ؟ بِمَ تَشْعُرُ فيها؟ أَيْنَ تَقْضي العيدَ؟ ماذا تَفْعَلُ بَعْدَ الطَّوافِ؟

q.en: What does مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ في مَكَّةَ؟ ask?
q.ur: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ في مَكَّةَ؟ kya poochta hai?

options: What do you do in Makkah?
When do you go to Makkah?

q.en: What does أَيْنَ تَقْضِي أَيَّامَ العِيدِ؟ ask?
q.ur: أَيْنَ تَقْضِي أَيَّامَ العِيدِ؟ kya poochta hai?

options: Where do you spend the Eid days?
What do you eat at Eid?

q.en: Which is a correct answer to أَيْنَ تَقْضِي العُطْلَةَ؟
q.ur: أَيْنَ تَقْضِي العُطْلَةَ؟ ka sahi jawab kaunsa hai?

title.en: Reading: Saeed and Ahmad's Umrah, Mahmoud's story
title.ur: Parhna: Saeed aur Ahmad ki Umrah, Mahmood ki kahani

intro.en: Read short passages: Saeed leaves his country for Umrah, wears the Ihram, says the Talbiyah, circles the Kaaba seven times, walks between Safa and Marwa and shaves his head. Then Ahmad's Umrah, and Mahmoud, a student from Thailand.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum chhote paragraph parhte hain: Saeed Umrah ke liye watan se nikalta hai, Ihram pehenta hai, talbiyah kehta hai, Kaaba ke saat chakkar lagata hai, Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan sai karta hai aur sar mundwata hai. Phir Ahmad ki Umrah aur Thailand ke talib-e-ilm Mahmood ki kahani.
intro.ar: اِقْرَأْ فِقْراتٍ قَصيرَةً: يُغادِرُ سَعيدٌ بَلَدَهُ لِلْعُمْرَةِ، وَيَلْبَسُ الإِحْرامَ، وَيُلَبّي، وَيَطوفُ بِالكَعْبَةِ سَبْعًا، وَيَسْعى بَيْنَ الصَّفا وَالمَرْوَةِ، وَيَحْلِقُ رَأْسَهُ. ثُمَّ عُمْرَةُ أَحْمَدَ، وَمَحْمودٌ طالِبٌ مِنْ تايْلَنْد.

q.en: Why did Saeed leave his country?
q.ur: Saeed ne apna watan kyun chhoda?

q.en: What did Saeed wear at the Miqat?
q.ur: Saeed ne Miqat par kya pehna?

q.en: How many circuits did Saeed walk around the Kaaba?
q.ur: Saeed ne Kaaba ke kitne chakkar lagaye?
q.ar: كَمْ شَوْطًا طافَ سَعيدٌ حَوْلَ الكَعْبَةِ؟

q.en: Where did Ahmad take off his Ihram clothes?
q.ur: Ahmad ne Ihram ke kapde kahan utaare?

q.en: What did Mahmoud come to Makkah to study?
q.ar: ماذا جاءَ مَحْمودٌ لِيَدْرُسَ في مَكَّةَ؟

intro.en: Write Hajj and Umrah words: join letters to make words, put letters in order, name pictures with verbs, and copy sentences such as 'Saeed left his country for Umrah'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Hajj aur Umrah ke alfaaz likhte hain: harf jod kar lafz banate hain, harf tarteeb se lagate hain, tasweeron ke neeche fe'l likhte hain aur jumle naql karte hain.
intro.ar: اُكْتُبْ كَلِماتِ الحَجِّ وَالعُمْرَةِ: صِلِ الحُروفَ لِتُكَوِّنَ كَلِماتٍ، وَرَتِّبِ الحُروفَ، وَسَمِّ الصُّوَرَ بِأَفْعالٍ، وَانْسَخْ جُمَلًا مِثْلَ «غادَرَ سَعيدٌ بَلَدَهُ لِلْعُمْرَةِ».

q.ur: Kaunsa lafz 'woh tawaf karta hai' hai?
Kaunsa lafz 'woh jharu deta hai' hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ فِعْلٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى التَّنْظيفِ بِالمِكْنَسَةِ؟

q.ur: Kaunsa lafz 'woh zibah karta hai' hai?

q.en: Which is the correct question: 'How did you perform Umrah, father?'
q.ur: Sahi sawal: 'Abbu, aap ne Umrah kaise ki?'
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ صَحيحٌ لِتَسْأَلَ أَباكَ عَنْ كَيْفِيَّةِ أَدائِهِ العُمْرَةَ؟

intro.en: Review the words and ideas from this unit and the one before it: vocabulary, opposites, words in context and short questions.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum is unit aur pichle unit ke alfaaz aur khayalaat dohrate hain: lughat, ulte alfaaz, jumlon mein istemal aur chhote sawal.
intro.ar: راجِعِ الكَلِماتِ وَالأَفْكارَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الوِحْدَةِ وَالَّتي قَبْلَها: المُفْرَداتُ، وَالأَضْدادُ، وَالكَلِماتُ في السِّياقِ، وَالأَسْئِلَةُ القَصيرَةُ.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الزَّمَنِ؟
